content.short: Partior is a bank-owned blockchain network for atomic clearing and settlement of cross-border payments and FX.
content.description: Partior was set up by DBS, J.P. Morgan and Temasek to fix the part of correspondent banking where a payment leaves one bank and nobody can say where it is. Both legs of a transaction settle at the same instant on a shared ledger, so the risk of one side paying and the other failing simply does not arise, and it runs continuously rather than on business hours. Standard Chartered, Deutsche Bank and Emirates NBD are among the banks on the network. Backers include Temasek, Peak XV, Valor and Jump Crypto.
